title: Price restored fixed-port connectors at 67 operations (no κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

With every child call on the original dirty connector port, return that connector unchanged and one paid clean auxiliary to zero. The only added data operations are two directed full-row XORs and at most one reset. The exact five-source unit-price optimum with the auxiliary is **67 operations before its provision**, versus **74** on the original alphabet. If provision costs ρ, the exact comparison is **min(74, 67 + ρ)**.

The pinned width-16 tariff gives **35,060** with the fixed port, down **5,694** from the original restored **40,754**. #5372's **34,944** retargeted price is lower where the child port is free to move. The result is a scoped theorem and tariff witness. **No κ or selected record change.**

## Task and overlap

`connector-alphabet-change`, priority revision 8; [scope claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19557083). Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. #7324 consumes the old port; #5372 moves the port; #2182 uses an arbitrary dirty companion and paired reads. The new proof prices the restored fixed-port boundary, including interleaved moves and repeated readouts.

## Validation

`python3.12 -I -B research/fixed-port-connector-reset/verify.py` checks 24 symbolic words, 12 exact small optima, a fixed singular-map limit, and each of three wrappers on all 608 pinned basis inputs with a separate target oracle. Seven failure controls cover the saved value, closure, zeroing, and reset cap. Registered replay, optimized replay, Git-free export and replay, source history, committed bytes and modes passed locally. This branch reuses the unchanged #7257 CI prerequisites; the research is one new commit.

## Credit and next question

Nick Petalas's #7324 supplies the reset and open Gray path; #934, #2063, #1954 and #5372 supply the interface, exact restored comparator, fixture and closed Gray baseline. OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT Pro materially assisted formulation, adversarial review and replay. The next gate is one actual multiplication caller with the same fixed ports, a complete charged clean-row lifetime, and complete physical and recursive prices. The declared local tariff does not supply that binding.
